annotations.title: How booking a Fuse room works

description: Explain how a student books a Fuse room in Budapest or Riga: the steps from choosing a room to moving in, as the site runs them now, the documents to upload, the fee, deposit and first rent and when each is paid, who the tenancy agreement is with, and why only the student can book (the booking includes an ID check). Read only: it never books, holds, pays, uploads or signs; the student books on the room's own page.
